performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 28 days; organic holding but GBP just collapsed.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend = $0 for all 28 days in the series. Zero leads, zero CPL. Campaigns are confirmed off, not underperforming.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 8 consecutive days (Aug 23–30), down from a peak of 19 on Aug 17. -100% delta confirms a listing-level event, not noise.
SOW extension with Marwan is open and unresolved; engagement lapsed after June. No paid work can resume without a signed contract — this gates all buyer actions.
Search clicks rose +18.92% 7d vs prior 7d (recent days show 43 clicks on Aug 24 and 26), but GBP and Meta are both dark — organic SEO is the only channel generating any signal.
GHL shows 23 contacts and 0 opportunities created in 28 days with 0 paid leads. Contacts likely residual; pipeline is effectively empty and will not self-recover without ads resuming.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP listing immediately — 8 days of zero actions on a previously active profile signals suspension or critical error.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped from 19 on Aug 17 to 0 across all 8 days Aug 23–30, a confirmed -100% collapse. Check Google Business Profile for suspension notice, ownership conflict, or policy flag and resolve immediately. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to ≥5/day, consistent with the Aug 3–17 baseline. Re-check by Sep 3.

suggestions.text: Hold all paid reactivation (Meta $65–75/day) until Marwan extension is signed — no budget move is in scope while contract is lapsed.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta campaigns have been at $0 spend for the full 28-day window and the SOW extension with Marwan has lapsed. Zero paid actions are appropriate until the contract is executed. Once signed, the prior $65–75/day Meta budget and CROA campaign structure (Broad – IMGs, All Videos, GRT, Freedom ad sets) are the established reactivation blueprint. Re-check contract status by Sep 7.
